operations.details: Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium OGC API – Moving Features page.
Moving-object state separated from static parcel terrain evidence.
Location/time query capability not promoted to survey accuracy.
Static DTM acquisition and vertical uncertainty remain independently required.
Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium Location Service (OpenLS) page.
Location-service output separated from direct terrain observation.
Routing/proximity coordinates not promoted to parcel-height evidence.
Measurement source, datum and vertical error budget remain required.
Both OGC API Moving Features and OGC OpenLS URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No service/model/encoding value substituted for parcel terrain measurement without independent lineage.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
